evals.prompt: For the content operations phased delivery plan, who owns browser automation, and does RedNote or Xiaohongshu fall inside the MVP scope? Check the plan before answering.
evals.expected_output: The governing plan sections are located through the index with a runtime digest check, and the answer names the section and line range used for the authentication/browser-ownership and RedNote/Xiaohongshu scope questions.
expectations: The skill opens references/content-operations-delivery-plan-index.md before reading the plan.
The current sha256 digest of docs/architecture/content_operations_phased_delivery_plan.md is recomputed and compared with the recorded digest.
A mismatch or unindexed state triggers a heading re-extraction rather than reuse of recorded line ranges.
Only the matching section ranges are read; the whole plan is not dumped.
The reply reports a freshness status and cites the governing heading and line range.

evals.prompt: Summarize the retry and backoff behavior documented in docs/architecture/event_bus_retry_policy.md and recommend a safer timeout.
evals.expected_output: The content operations delivery plan index is not consulted, because the request is about an unrelated repository document.
expectations: The answer works from the named event bus document or reports that it must be read.
